title: A3: real requests from every existing project route to where the person went
description: The eval set (~/.foundry/pa-eval/set, built from the person's real first messages across their projects, de-identified, plus handwritten new/ask/answer cases) is replayed on a scratch copy of the dev database with the eval's own chats hidden. Without a model, find_workspace must put the gold project first for ≥ 90% of clear cases. With a real model on a sample, the §13 gates hold: clear top-1 ≥ 90%, wrong dispatch when going ahead ≤ 3%, asks on ambiguous ≥ 80%, “should create” precision and recall ≥ 85%, banned words 0, ≤ 0.2 questions per request.
preconditions: The server includes WP-S1 and WP-S2; the e2e step also WP-P and a native model login.

steps.value: find_workspace for every clear case, no model
assistant sessions on a stratified sample; helpers cancelled at once
